notes.title: Urgent update to build 927
notes.notes:
We have received several reports about crashes right on the game launch and decided to release an urgent build 927.

 - Resolution slider in video options could duplicate display resolutions

 - Added Windows XP support for workshop installer

 - Fixed corrupted rendering of file size string in workshop installer

 - Fixed interface bugs after sorting items in workshop installer

 - Workshop installer was not detecting the game if installation path was different 
from default location

 - Item description could overlap installation button in workshop installer

 - Now player starts with $25000 of cash

 - More vehicles are available for purchase in the beginning of player's career

 - If player wins Race of Champions, he will not loose entry fee now

 - Game could crash right on the launch, Steam achievements are temprorarilly disabled to fix this issue

WARNING: Steam achievements don't work right now, since the game is crashing on some computers because of them, we're working very hard to find out why that happens and enable them back as soon as possible. If you want Steam achievements anyway, let us know in the comments, we can make a special patch for you.

This build DOES NOT include multiplayer yet, it's about to come soon. Please, be patient.

notes.title: Minor update
notes.notes:
We decided to release this update as soon as possible. It has only two improvements:

 - Improved tail lights
 - Fixed random reset of career progress

Career should not drop you back to the last position in Green Slip racing club anymore. If this will happen once again, please, let us know. Tail light rays may blink due to some internal limitations on dynamic lights in this game engine, this will be improved in the future.

NOTICE: old savegame files may not work! If the game keeps crashing when loading them, start new career.

notes.title: Important update
notes.notes:
We have finally announced an important upgrade to build 917.

- Improved code of game initialization and options menu
- Fixed random behavior of hidden settings menu
- Fixed random switching to 640x480 resolution in fullscreen mode after accessing options menu
- Improved blower hood mesh for Hauler's Badge (thanks to ramrom for that)
- Fixed incorrect names of some tuner parts for Stallion (thanks to ramrom)

== WARNING! YOUR OLD SAVEGAME WILL BE LOST AFTER THIS UPDATE. IF YOU TRY TO LOAD IT, GAME WILL CRASH. ==

In order to fix the issues with saving game settings, we had to modify the structure of savegame files. For safe transition to build 917 follow the instructions below:

1. Delete all old careers and start new one;
2. If the game won't start or if it shows "Create hw 3d device FAILED", uninstall it from Steam (right-click on the game, select "Delete local content", then go to game folder and delete ALL files from there, install the game again)
3. If neither of steps above help, contact support@image-code.com for help.

If you want to enable cheats, to the following:

1. Go to your game folder (usually located at Program Files\Steam\steamapps\common\Street Legal Racing Redline v2.3.1)
2. Open file Player.java in sl\scripts\game\src\
3. Look for these lines of code:

[code]
int		c_enabled	= 0; //defines if player has access to cheats menu
int		c_garage	= 0; //garage codes: money, car selector, roc teleporter, etc.
int		c_track		= 0; //track cheats: slowmotion, osd on/off, freeze, etc.
int		c_eventlist	= 0; //eventlist stuff: join any race, one-click prize
int		c_catalog	= 0; //show/hide kits in catalog
int		c_autosave	= 1; //automatic career progress save
int		c_ghost		= 0; //no drivers in vehicles
[/code]

Replace with these:

/code]
int		c_enabled	= 1; //defines if player has access to cheats menu
int		c_garage	= 1; //garage codes: money, car selector, roc teleporter, etc.
int		c_track		= 1; //track cheats: slowmotion, osd on/off, freeze, etc.
int		c_eventlist	= 1; //eventlist stuff: join any race, one-click prize
int		c_catalog	= 1; //show/hide kits in catalog
int		c_autosave	= 1; //automatic career progress save
int		c_ghost		= 1; //no drivers in vehicles
[/code]

Save this file, run the game again, START NEW CAREER and save it.

notes.title: Minor stability update
notes.notes:
We are releasing an urgent update to build 909 that should completely eliminate game crash after exit.

If you're still experiencing this bug, please tell us in the comments to this news post and try to describe what did you do in the game in the last few minutes before closing it.

notes.title: Steam release
notes.notes:
We're glad to tell you that the game is moving to Steam!

If you have already purchased an activation key at getstreetlegal.com it will be transferred to Steam soon, please be patient. This version includes all previously released automatic updates and also, it does not need launcher anymore, you can just run it from Steam.
